title: Dawnice Completes 5MWh Solar + Storage Project in Zambia (February 2026)
summary: A 5MWh solar-plus-storage plant completed in Zambia, delivered with local stakeholders.
challenge: Zambia faces frequent outages and depends heavily on non-renewable generation, which limits supply to communities and businesses.
solution: A 5MWh solar and storage plant built as utility-scale infrastructure.
result: Stable renewable supply for the surrounding communities and businesses, with less reliance on fossil generation.
